title: Positive Planning after Project Feedback
conversation_text:
I feel proud because I finally finished my project.
My professor gave me some positive feedback.
I feel more motivated to keep improving it.
I want to plan my next steps and make it even better.

title: Breakup and Emotional Escalation
conversation_text:
I just broke up with my girlfriend. I feel terrible.
I don't know what to do now.
My life feels so empty.
I can't calm down. Everything feels too much.

title: Ambiguous Study Planning
conversation_text:
I want to plan my next steps and make it better.
Maybe on study.
I want to focus more and improve my learning habits.
Can you help me make a simple plan for tomorrow?

title: Sarcastic Product Complaint
conversation_text:
Great, another update that breaks everything.
I just love waiting forever for this app to load.
Now I cannot even finish my work on time.
What should I do now?

title: Interview Anxiety and Reassurance
conversation_text:
I am worried about my interview.
I keep thinking I might fail.
I prepared, but I still feel nervous.
Can you reassure me a little?

title: Overwhelmed but Starting to Plan
conversation_text:
I feel really overwhelmed by all my deadlines.
I don't know where to start.
Maybe I should make a list first.
Can you help me choose the first step?

title: Low Motivation and Boredom
conversation_text:
My life feels so boring lately.
I don't feel excited about anything.
I just scroll on my phone for hours.
I wish I could find something meaningful to do.

title: Recovery after Initial Anxiety
conversation_text:
I felt really anxious about my presentation yesterday.
I practiced again and now I feel a little better.
I still worry that I might forget something.
Can you help me review the key points one more time?
